topics.label: Factor Mining / 因子挖掘
topics.description: Discover and select reusable alpha signals or formulas; distinguish predictive alpha from economic pricing factors. / 发现与筛选可复用的收益信号或公式，区别于经济定价因子。
topics.evaluation_zh: 检查样本外 IC、因子冗余、搜索预算、换手与成本。
topics.evaluation_en: Check out-of-sample IC, signal redundancy, search budget, turnover and costs.

topics.label: Time Series / 时间序列
topics.description: Forecast, represent, generate or reconstruct financial sequences; a specific asset-value target belongs to valuation prediction. / 金融序列预测、表征、生成与重建；明确的资产价值目标归估值预测。
topics.evaluation_zh: 使用严格时间切分，分别报告预测误差、概率校准及合成质量。
topics.evaluation_en: Use chronological splits and separate forecast error, probabilistic calibration and synthesis quality.

topics.label: Pricing / 定价
topics.description: Asset pricing mechanisms, risk premia, derivative valuation and calibration; distinguish pricing relationships from predictive price targets. / 资产定价机制、风险溢价、衍生品估价与校准，区别于价格预测。
topics.evaluation_zh: 核验无套利约束、定价误差、对冲误差及交易假设。
topics.evaluation_en: Test no-arbitrage constraints, pricing error, hedging error and trading assumptions.

topics.label: Valuation Prediction / 估值预测
topics.description: Predict asset prices, returns, volatility, enterprise value, earnings or revenue. / 预测资产价格、收益、波动率、企业价值、盈利与营收。
topics.evaluation_zh: 同时核对时间泄漏、预测目标、跨市场泛化和经济效用。
topics.evaluation_en: Check temporal leakage, target definitions, cross-market transfer and economic utility.

topics.label: Portfolio / 投资组合
topics.description: Select, allocate, rebalance and evaluate portfolios across assets. / 跨资产组合选择、配置、再平衡与评价。
topics.evaluation_zh: 统一成本与调仓频率，报告收益、回撤、风险及换手。
topics.evaluation_en: Match costs and rebalancing frequency; report return, drawdown, risk and turnover.

topics.label: Insurance and Actuarial Science / 保险精算
topics.description: Insurance underwriting, claims, reserves, actuarial prediction and insurance business decisions. / 承保、理赔、准备金、精算预测及保险业务决策。
topics.evaluation_zh: 关注索赔分布、校准、选择偏差、长期风险及业务约束。
topics.evaluation_en: Inspect claim distributions, calibration, selection bias, long-term risk and business constraints.

topics.label: Financial Sentiment / 金融情感
topics.description: Financial sentiment, stance, tone and emotion as the prediction target; downstream return prediction stays valuation prediction. / 以金融情感、立场、语气与情绪为目标；下游收益预测仍归估值预测。
topics.evaluation_zh: 检查标注口径、时效性、领域与语言迁移，区分情感准确率和收益效果。
topics.evaluation_en: Check annotation policy, temporal drift and domain/language transfer; separate sentiment accuracy from returns.

topics.label: Financial Question Answering / 金融问答
topics.description: Answer financial questions and perform numerical, table or conversational reasoning. / 金融问题回答及数值、表格、对话推理。
topics.evaluation_zh: 分别检查答案、推理程序、证据引用及跨表跨文档一致性。
topics.evaluation_en: Evaluate answers, reasoning programs, evidence attribution and cross-table/document consistency separately.

topics.label: Financial Understanding / 金融理解
topics.description: Extract, interpret, summarize and verify financial language, reports, charts, invoices and accounting records. / 金融文本、财报、图表、票据及会计记录的抽取、解释、摘要与核验。
topics.evaluation_zh: 关注结构提取、数值忠实性、证据覆盖及版面变化。
topics.evaluation_en: Measure structural extraction, numerical faithfulness, evidence coverage and layout shift.

topics.label: Financial Decision Making / 金融决策
topics.description: Trading, execution, market simulation and financial agent decisions; portfolio allocation has its own task. / 交易、执行、市场仿真与金融 Agent 决策；组合配置单列。
topics.evaluation_zh: 区分离线预测与闭环决策，显式计入交易成本、延迟和市场冲击。
topics.evaluation_en: Separate offline prediction from closed-loop decisions; include costs, latency and market impact.

topics.label: Sustainable Finance / 可持续金融
topics.description: ESG disclosure, greenwashing, climate-related financial analysis and sustainable investment. / ESG 披露、漂绿、气候金融分析与可持续投资。
topics.evaluation_zh: 核对披露证据、跨期可比性、行业偏差和实际投资约束。
topics.evaluation_en: Check disclosure evidence, temporal comparability, sector bias and investment constraints.

topics.label: Financial Services / 金融服务
topics.description: Banking, payments, customer service, marketing and personal/business financial services. / 银行、支付、客户服务、营销及个人与企业金融服务。
topics.evaluation_zh: 区分公开业务数据与真实部署，检查客户、时间和机构间迁移。
topics.evaluation_en: Distinguish public business data from deployment; check transfer across customers, time and institutions.

topics.label: Blockchain / 区块链
topics.description: Blockchain transactions, digital assets, smart contracts and DeFi mechanisms. / 链上交易、数字资产、智能合约与 DeFi 机制。
topics.evaluation_zh: 关注链与协议差异、时间切分、攻击假设及链上成本。
topics.evaluation_en: Check chain/protocol differences, chronological splits, attack assumptions and on-chain costs.

topics.label: Financial Safety / 金融安全
topics.description: Fraud, scams, money laundering, privacy, attacks and regulatory compliance. / 欺诈、诈骗、反洗钱、隐私、攻击与监管合规。
topics.evaluation_zh: 重视类别不平衡、误报成本、攻击适应性、隐私与合规证据。
topics.evaluation_en: Account for imbalance, false-positive costs, adaptive attacks, privacy and compliance evidence.

topics.label: Financial Retrieval / 金融检索
topics.description: Retrieve, embed, rerank and ground financial evidence, including financial RAG. / 金融证据检索、嵌入、重排及 RAG。
topics.evaluation_zh: 分开报告检索召回、重排质量、引用忠实性和最终回答质量。
topics.evaluation_en: Report retrieval recall, reranking, citation faithfulness and answer quality separately.

topics.label: Financial Evaluation / 金融评测
topics.description: The main contribution is a financial dataset, benchmark, evaluation environment or capability audit. / 主要贡献为金融数据集、基准、评测环境或能力诊断。
topics.evaluation_zh: 检查覆盖、污染、标注质量、评测预算与指标外推边界。
topics.evaluation_en: Inspect coverage, contamination, annotation quality, evaluation budget and limits of metric extrapolation.

topics.label: Financial Models / 金融模型
topics.description: Financial domain pretraining, adaptation and reusable foundation models; generic time-series pretraining stays time series. / 金融领域预训练、适配与可复用基础模型；通用序列预训练仍归时间序列。
topics.evaluation_zh: 检查预训练数据、时间污染、跨任务迁移、模型规模和计算预算。
topics.evaluation_en: Audit pretraining data, temporal contamination, cross-task transfer, model size and compute budget.

topics.label: Financial Risk / 金融风险
topics.description: Credit scoring, default, market, liquidity and systemic risk; fraud and attacks belong to financial safety. / 信用评分、违约、市场风险、流动性及系统性风险；欺诈与攻击归金融安全。
topics.evaluation_zh: 关注违约与尾部事件、概率校准、成本敏感性、压力测试及跨期稳定性。
topics.evaluation_en: Evaluate default and tail events, calibration, cost sensitivity, stress tests and temporal stability.
